Content & privacy

Original SAT-style exercises are written for this app. Official question text is not bundled; the Android reader retrieves the original PDFs, verifies their fingerprints, and renders questions on the device. No analytics, advertising, or remote progress storage.

SAT is a trademark of College Board. SATflow is an independent study tool and is not endorsed by College Board.
